lines.text: And you've carried a one hundred and sixty pound human your whole life.
But you were never supposed to do it alone.
You see, wrapped around your waist sits a hidden corset muscle.
It squeezes your spine armor-tight, and locks every vertebra in place.
Then we all sat down... and the corset got switched off.
So your back muscles carry everything alone.
Back ache finds you. You stretch. You crack it.
The re-hiring interview is the laziest pose on earth: hold one push-up, and... don't move.
Because the stillness is the whole trick.
The world record stands at nine hours, thirty eight minutes.
You only need three sets, of thirty seconds.
And a review of two hundred and seventy studies found these exact holds drop blood pressure better than any other exercise.
Your back isn't weak. It's out of a job.
Follow for one move every day.
